description: The US House Oversight Committee heard a closed-door hearing where several victims of Jeffrey Epstein testified about their experiences and urged lawmakers to release all related files to the public.
headline: Epstein Victims Offer Testimony in Closed-Door Oversight Committee Hearing

info.description: 2025-09-03: Reps. Ro Khanna (D-CA), Thomas Massie (R-KY), and Marjorie Talyor Greene (R-GA) held a press conference in the morning calling on lawmakers to sign a discharge petition that would compel the public release of all files related to the Jeffrey Epstein case.
info.note: They were accompanied by victims who spoke the previous day in the closed-door hearing.

info.description: Rep. Greene states that President Trump called her after this conference to voice his displeasure at her, and the call is corroborated by her staffers.
info.note: She claims that when she pushed for Trump to explain why he was being stubborn over the files, that he offered, "my friends will get hurt," as an explanation.
